party_a_name: The Bon-Ton Stores, Inc. and its associated chapter 11 debtors in possession (collectively, "Merchant")
party_b_name: (a) a contractual joint venture comprised of GA Retail, Inc. and Tiger Capital Group, LLC (collectively, the "Agent") and (b) Wilmington Savings Fund Society, FSB, as the indenture agent and collateral trustee for the 8.00% second-lien senior secured notes due 2021 (the "Notes Trustee" and collectively with Agent, "Purchaser")
liability_cap: Purchaser shall not be liable for any claims against Merchant except as expressly provided for in this Agreement (no specific monetary cap stated).
risk_explanation: This is a complex bankruptcy-related agency/liquidation agreement with extensive operational obligations, escrow/trust arrangements, and court-supervised processes, which is atypical and high-risk for a small SaaS vendor. There is no clear monetary limitation of liability; instead it broadly limits Purchaser liability only to what is expressly assumed, creating uncertainty rather than a defined cap. Term/termination mechanics are specialized (store-by-store vacate notice) and not a simple convenience termination framework.
